parts.story: Omar lives in a small apartment near a busy street. He is an artist, and he draws pictures for a magazine. Next month he is going to move downtown, because his new office is there. His new job has a better salary, so he will buy a new car. He is not going to sell his old bicycle. "I will ride it in the park every Sunday," he says.
